mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, tier_data, created_at, updated_at FROM tier_list_history WHERE user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT id, user_id, title, tier_data, created_at, updated_at FROM tier_list_history WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tier_list_history (user_id, title, tier_data, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{title}, #{tier_data}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE tier_list_history SET title = #{title}, tier_data = #{tier_data}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{user_id}
